[LSIG.5.1] Under `realtime` and `linear_scan: false`, `SeriesBackendIntervalPulse`, `SeriesBackendNumericIntegral`, and the
`SeriesBackendRingBuffer`-backed `onset_rate` each require a `series[i].capacity` entry in the
`.dsrt` — the maximum number of transitions (`SeriesBackendIntervalPulse`, `SeriesBackendRingBuffer`) or samples (`SeriesBackendNumericIntegral`)
expected in the window. The runtime sizes the backing from it at load time;
the running sums are O(1) regardless. This is the capacity discipline already
governing `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` ([LNLS.3.5]).
